freedom.title: Financial Freedom
freedom.formula: Freedom = investable assets × 3% ÷ annual budget total
freedom.numeratorBreakdown: Numerator = market value + investment account balance (converted to native currency; living cash and liabilities excluded)
freedom.denominatorBreakdown: Denominator = monthly budget × 12 + annual budget (annualized at planned pace; does not fall back to actual spending)
freedom.extractionRate: 3% is the conservative safe withdrawal rate; ≥100% means financially free
freedom.zeroDenominator: Set a budget to unlock Financial Freedom

itemCost.title: Item Daily Cost
itemCost.subtitle: Total daily cost of all active items
